scope: One-shot exposed-development screen: actual vocal-specialist inference on10existing clips plus cached native presence outputs; not a full current-app run.
selected_direction: Vocal-specialist admission; relative-role training and full-backbone rewrite deferred. Producer-role AI judgment, not human validation.

owner_contract.primary: Accepted manual lead in actual final capped list.

policy: Mean native per-patch instrumental/voice softmax; voice only when mean voice exceeds instrumental. Voice branch: Vocal plus highest native non-Vocal identity; otherwise cached native top two. Downstream rule is ours, not publisher-default. No tuning.

partial.interpretation: Partial/shared positive containment only, not complete shared-leader accuracy; excluded from clear primary prospectively

limits: Repeatedly exposed development; unknown head and backbone pretraining overlap, no independent/general accuracy claim.
Only four clear categories; partial known-positive Vocal miss remains, two unclear cases unscored. Lead labels do not establish vocal-presence precision.
No measured reliability improvement, app adoption, timed or broad evaluation. Private noncommercial research only; future commercial scope needs renewed review.
